summary.name: Schleuder
summary.one_liner: Schleuder is an encrypting mailing list manager that uses OpenPGP so group members can exchange encrypted email, with remailing to and from non-subscribers.
use_cases: Running an encrypted group mailing list
Exchanging OpenPGP-encrypted email among group subscribers
Receiving and sending list mail to non-subscribers through a group gateway
Hosting private communication for activist or community groups
Administering a self-hosted encrypted list server
summary.what_it_does: Schleuder acts as a group's email gateway. Subscribers can exchange OpenPGP-encrypted emails with each other through the list. It can also receive emails from non-subscribers and send emails to non-subscribers via the list. The page describes documentation for subscribers, list admins and server admins, and points to an issue tracker for development. The page text gives few further technical details.
notable: OpenPGP-encrypted messages exchanged among list subscribers
Remailing: relays mail to and from non-subscribers
Documentation split by subscriber, list admin and server admin roles
Licensed GPL-3.0 and written in Ruby (per awesome-selfhosted listing)
caveats: Platform requirements are not stated on the page text provided
